referencePolicy: C&C3 Tiberium Wars, Supreme Commander 2, XCOM 2 and StarCraft II are visual-language references only; copying or tracing protected assets is forbidden.

planets.biome: temperate civic ecumenopolis belts threaded through green river basins, working coastal yards and an arctic high shelf
planets.atmosphere: clean nitrogen-oxygen sky with a restrained blue-cyan limb, thin white weather bands and visible city-light arcs on the night side
planets.hazards: river flood gates, high-shelf icing, coastal surge and damaged civic power—not planetary collapse
planets.orbitalSilhouette: blue-green sphere, bright managed coastlines, four inhabited infrastructure arcs, a pale high-shelf cap, no rings
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: cool civic concrete, planted drainage, dark wet asphalt, pale transit composite, cyan occupied glazing, maintained steel and restrained municipal markings
planets.factionLoreContext: Nova/TFC beginner theatre and living capital. Civilians, logistics and transit remain functional; destruction is localized and legible.

planets.biome: sunlit cloud-forest mesas and champagne-colored inland seas separated by white limestone escarpments
planets.atmosphere: deep oxygen-rich turquoise atmosphere with tall pearl thunderheads and a warm gold terminator
planets.hazards: mesa-edge rockfall, hypercell downbursts, flash-flood canyons and lightning-charged cloud banks
planets.orbitalSilhouette: turquoise oceans, ivory mesa chains, emerald cloud forests and a distinctive broken halo of high-altitude storm anvils
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: ivory limestone, warm pale concrete, teal ceramic, brushed champagne alloy, dark rain channels and amber weather glass
planets.factionLoreContext: UGA diplomatic retreat and meteorology reserve where Coalition enclaves share elevated settlements above protected cloud forests.

planets.biome: global ocean broken by basalt archipelagos, floating kelp farms, abyssal trenches and storm-built reef shelves
planets.atmosphere: dense blue-grey maritime atmosphere with spiral silver storms, turquoise equatorial shallows and violet night lightning
planets.hazards: rogue waves, salt corrosion, deck flooding, hydrothermal vents and collapsing reef shelves
planets.orbitalSilhouette: deep cobalt water world with turquoise reef necklaces, sparse black islands and one enormous silver cyclone eye
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: salt-etched marine steel, black basalt, blue pressure glass, wet anti-slip deck, pale buoyancy ceramic and copper biofouling barriers
planets.factionLoreContext: UGA oceanographic frontier and Coalition food reserve; settlements are modular, amphibious and connected by heavy causeways.

planets.biome: humid emerald highlands beneath continent-scale fern canopies, quartz rivers and luminous mineral wetlands
planets.atmosphere: green-blue humid limb with broad white monsoon bands and faint magenta mineral auroras
planets.hazards: monsoon floods, corrosive pollen, root heave, sinkholes and quartz-river electrical discharge
planets.orbitalSilhouette: emerald continents cut by silver quartz rivers, dark canopy basins and magenta wetland glints
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: dark basalt soil, pale quartz aggregate, moss-resistant green ceramic, copper mesh, smoked glass and bright drainage channels
planets.factionLoreContext: Coalition xenobotany preserve with strict ecological corridors; settlements rise above the canopy floor rather than flatten it.

planets.biome: red-black crater courts, storm-scoured factory belts, caldera arcologies and exposed orbital flats
planets.atmosphere: dense red-orange storm limb, dark ash bands and violent gold-white lightning along the terminator
planets.hazards: electrical superstorms, thermal vents, ash abrasion, pressure loss and foundry heat
planets.orbitalSilhouette: iron-red sphere with black industrial belts, luminous calderas and rotating storm scars, no organic surface read
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: iron basalt, red pressure ceramic, black blast steel, smoked amber glass, scorched apron concrete and disciplined Dominion hazard marks
planets.factionLoreContext: Crimson Dominion homeworld; monumental pressure infrastructure and mech production express hierarchy, endurance and controlled violence.

planets.biome: iron-oxide deserts, magnetite mesas, nickel dunes and deep blue shadow canyons
planets.atmosphere: thin copper haze with sharp cobalt horizon and sweeping green magnetic auroras
planets.hazards: magnetic storms, conductive dust, compass failure, rail-charge discharge and canyon collapse
planets.orbitalSilhouette: rust-red world striped by black magnetite ranges, cobalt crater shadows and thin green auroral horns
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: layered rust stone, black magnetite, gunmetal infrastructure, cobalt ceramic insulation, conductive copper mesh and pale dust seals
planets.factionLoreContext: Syndicate resource frontier where autonomous rail cities harvest rare metals under severe electromagnetic weather.

planets.biome: volcanic island arcs, obsidian deltas, ash forests and lava-cut black beaches under perpetual ember rain
planets.atmosphere: charcoal atmosphere with orange volcanic plumes, crimson limb glow and ash-ringed polar vortices
planets.hazards: lava advance, ash burial, pyroclastic wind, toxic vents and sudden caldera subsidence
planets.orbitalSilhouette: black-red planet with branching orange lava deltas, grey ash continents and multiple towering plume shadows
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: black obsidian, vesicular basalt, heat-white ceramic, dark refractory alloy, smoked red glass and ashproof seals
planets.factionLoreContext: Dominion frontier proving ground and geothermal power reserve, settled in mobile heat-resistant enclaves rather than grand capitals.

planets.biome: high-gravity basalt tablelands, cyclopean mountain stairs and dense silver grass valleys beneath a compressed sky
planets.atmosphere: thick indigo lower atmosphere, pale silver cloud decks and a flattened amber horizon caused by high gravity
planets.hazards: slope failure, crushing storms, structural fatigue, dense fog and high-gravity vehicle rollover
planets.orbitalSilhouette: dark slate planet with vast stepped plateaus, silver valley seams and tightly wrapped cloud bands
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: massive basalt block, thick ribbed concrete, low-profile steel, silver grass mat, amber load glass and oversized bearing surfaces
planets.factionLoreContext: UGA heavy-engineering test world where all architecture demonstrates load paths, redundancy and short robust spans.

planets.biome: ice archipelagos, artillery-scarred machine cliffs, unstable reactor rifts and polar orbital-weather peaks
planets.atmosphere: cold blue-green limb, thin white ice clouds and non-organic green orbital-weather arcs
planets.hazards: ice fracture, blizzard whiteout, cryogenic coolant, meteor storms and automated industrial failures
planets.orbitalSilhouette: blue-white glacial sphere with dark machine grids, fractured archipelagos and geometric green orbital-weather traces
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: blue ice, dark automation alloy, pale cryo ceramic, conductive green glass, rime-streaked concrete and precise machine markings
planets.factionLoreContext: Syndicate robotic theatre; autonomous factories endure orbital weather and old frontline damage without organic visual language.

planets.biome: pearlescent salt terraces, opaline badlands, shallow caustic seas and shell-like mineral reefs
planets.atmosphere: milky lavender atmosphere with iridescent cloud bands and a pale cyan limb
planets.hazards: caustic fog, salt heave, mirror glare, brittle mineral collapse and corrosive tidal spray
planets.orbitalSilhouette: white-lavender world with mother-of-pearl continental swirls, cyan caustic seas and iridescent crescent bands
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: layered nacre mineral, matte white saltcrete, violet corrosion alloy, cyan sealed glass, dark gasket composite and prismatic ceramic accents
planets.factionLoreContext: Coalition chemistry and optics frontier whose settlements protect delicate mineral reefs while harvesting rare photonic compounds.

planets.biome: low-gravity cryovolcanic tundra, black methane-ice flats, luminous geyser fields and long twilight valleys
planets.atmosphere: thin navy atmosphere filled by immense green-violet auroral curtains and pale methane haze
planets.hazards: cryogeyser eruptions, brittle black ice, methane fog, electrostatic auroras and low-gravity debris trajectories
planets.orbitalSilhouette: midnight-blue world with black ice continents, cyan cryovolcanic cracks and two enormous green-violet auroral ovals
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: black ice, blue cryobasalt, pale aerogel composite, violet conductive film, low-mass trusswork and cyan thermal markers
planets.factionLoreContext: UGA deep-range science and fuel frontier; unlike industrial Nordhall, Borealis is sparse, low gravity and dominated by luminous cryovolcanism.
